title: Background and Academic Qualification Check of Mikhy Farrera-Brochez by Polytechnics
what_it_is: Background and Academic Qualification Check of Mikhy Farrera-Brochez by Polytechnics

sections.label: Polytechnic certificate verification checks
sections.summary: Temasek and Ngee Ann Polytechnics have incorporated stricter checks, including verifying educational certificates with issuing institutions.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: Temasek Polytechnic and Ngee Ann Polytechnic have since incorporated more stringent checks, including the verification of educational certificates with the issuing institutions.

sections.label: Polytechnic pre-employment checks and Brochez
sections.summary: All five polytechnics conduct pre-employment checks, and Mr Brochez taught at Temasek Polytechnic for two years and Ngee Ann Polytechnic for six months.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: Prior to making a hire, all our five polytechnics conduct pre-employment checks.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: This is in line with the public sector practice and also that of many companies in the private sector.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: These checks include background checks and also checking the applicants' academic qualifications against the original certificates.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: Since then, Temasek Polytechnic and Ngee Ann Polytechnic have tightened their checks to verify with the issuing institutions, not just for the foreign educational qualifications of new staff but also existing staff.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: In addition to that, since 2014, all our five polytechnics conduct reference checks with the applicant's previous employers or referees indicated in the application.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: On the second question, Mr Brochez taught at Temasek Polytechnic for a period of two years, from February 2009 to January 2011.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: He taught for a much shorter period of only six months as an Adjunct Lecturer at Ngee Ann Polytechnic.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: At that point in time, Temasek Polytechnic had a cohort of about 15,900 students, which means the number of students whom he taught represented about 0.5% of the cohort.
